svg.title: Time-phased MRP record of CC20-CAST, lot-for-lot
svg.text: 04 – Time-phased MRP record: CC20-CAST crankcase casting VC20 (weekly buckets, example values)
Item data: BUY · lead time LT = 2 weeks · safety stock SS = 300 · lot rule L4L · on hand at start 1 800 · open PO (scheduled receipt) 480 in week 1 · BOM 1 per VC20.
release week 1 (220) ▶ receipt week 3: LT = 2 weeks
How each column is calculated (week 3 as example)
projected before = end of week 2 + receipts − gross = 780 + 0 − 700 = 80 (below SS 300)
planned receipt = 220 (lot-for-lot: exactly the net) ▶ end of week 3 = 80 + 220 = 300
planned release = receipt week 3 − LT 2 = week 1: send the PO for 220 castings NOW
Releases in weeks 7–8 need gross requirements of weeks 9–10: the horizon must be longer than LT + lot cover.
Same item, 5 lot rules, 8 weeks (S = $80/order, H = $0.475/piece-week)
EOQ = 503 = 0.67 week of demand ▶ order every week ▶ L4L is cheapest here.
With a truck rule (480 per truck) FOQ costs +$751 in 8 weeks – the price of the truck.
gross to net, L4L, lead-time offset
